workload.enterprise_scenario: 20-Business-Unit Enterprise AI Platform (300 RPS Peak, 15B Tokens/Month across Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, Anthropic, and Self-Hosted AKS vLLM)
workload.governance_requirements: Token-Based Rate Limiting (TPM/RPM/USD), SSE Streaming Usage Accounting, <5ms 429/503 Failover, Keyless Entra ID/OIDC Auth, Semantic Caching

tiers.name: Tier 1: 应用直连 SDK / 传统 Nginx L7 反向代理 (仅按 HTTP 请求数限流，无 Token 感知)
tiers.name_en: Tier 1: Direct Provider SDK / Legacy Nginx L7 Proxy (RPS-Only, Token-Blind)
tiers.gateway_stack: Hardcoded Provider SDKs or Nginx location proxy_pass (No SSE Token Parser or TPM Limiter)
tiers.recommended_for: Single-team prototype only; dangerous in enterprise production due to leaked API keys and 128K-prompt noisy neighbors.

tiers.name: Tier 2: LiteLLM Proxy 敏捷多模型代理 (Python FastAPI + Postgres/Redis 虚拟 Key 分账)
tiers.name_en: Tier 2: LiteLLM Proxy Agile Multi-Model Gateway (Python FastAPI + Virtual Key Budgets)
tiers.gateway_stack: LiteLLM Proxy (8x Python Worker Pods + Redis TPM State + PostgreSQL Spend Ledger)
tiers.recommended_for: AI engineering teams & startups needing 100+ model schema normalization and team USD budgets within 1 day.

tiers.name: Tier 3: 云原生高性能 AI 网关 (Envoy AI Gateway / Higress / Kong AI Gateway · C++/Rust 数据面)
tiers.name_en: Tier 3: Cloud-Native High-Performance AI Gateway (Envoy AI Gateway / Higress / Kong on K8s)
tiers.gateway_stack: Envoy C++ / Rust Data Plane + K8s Gateway API + Wasm SSE Token Parser + Redis Sliding-Window TPM
tiers.recommended_for: Kubernetes-native platform teams (AKS/EKS) running hybrid cloud + self-hosted vLLM/SGLang at 300–5,000+ RPS.

tiers.name: Tier 4: 企业级全托管 AI 治理中枢 (Azure APIM AI Gateway + Entra ID 免密 + PTU/PAYGO 智能溢出)
tiers.name_en: Tier 4: Managed Enterprise AI Governance Hub (Azure APIM AI Gateway + Entra ID + Smart Spillover)
tiers.gateway_stack: Azure API Management (llm-token-limit + llm-emit-token-metric + llm-semantic-cache + Managed Identity + Multi-Region Pool)
tiers.recommended_for: Large enterprises standardizing on Azure AI Foundry + multi-cloud: zero gateway ops, 99.99% SLA, keyless RBAC, and FinOps integration.
